QuestInfo.name: Blaze Wizard Knighthood Exam
QuestInfo.0: According to #p1101002#, you can take the Knighthood Exam from Chief Knight of Fire #b#p1101004##k. Go to Ereve and meet #p1101004#.
QuestInfo.1: The Knighthood Exam has begun. It's quite simple. Go to #bThe 2nd Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest, and defeat the monster in it.\r\n#b(If you fail, forfeit the quest and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: You have completed the Knighthood Exam. You are no longer a Knight-in-Training, but a full-fledged official knight. Maintain your passion for the traditions of the Cygnus Knights.

default.0: Did you forget where to go? How cute! Just head to the #bSecond Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest and defeat the monster in it!

0.0: Wowee! Look at you! Advancing so fast that you're qualified to take the Knighthood Exam already, eh? Hey! Do you want to start right now? Like, right this second?
0.1: The exam is super simple. Remember the Training Forest? There's a room at the end called the #bSecond Drill Hall#k. Enter it and defeat 30 Tiguru of Exam creatures!
0.2: You'll be a full-fledged knight once you're done! Good luck, though I'm sure you don't need it!\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to #m130020000# automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Need some time to prepare? Let me know when you're ready!
